name: Coefficient Space of Convex-Geometry Ideals
scope: Finite nonempty convex-geometry ideal classes, up to signed-coordinate equivalence and suppression of constants.
proof: Such a class is an upper ideal in a learning space after coordinate reflection. Its retained positive source systems are empty, so every sufficiently small common scaling is feasible. The feasible-scaling theorem then identifies its full coefficient space with Euclidean space of the ambient coefficient dimension.
